description: CFD 2D soil stress model (S 200 1, quasi-static Biot u-p): periodic box 2.8 m x 0.7 m, sand bed S 57 0 (S 10 1, no transport), 0.5 m of soil below the bed (fine sand k 1e-4 m/s, Sr 0.975, Ev 1.333e7 Pa, nu 1/3), still water above, the bed pressure prescribed as a progressive wave 707 cos(kx - wt) Pa, L 2.8 m, T 1.5 s (S 217). Soil probes S 216 (p, u, liquefaction potential).
covers: soil_stress: classification, MINRES of the coupled u-p system, BDF2, the S 217 bed pressure
